audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows contradicted their own why-text. whys[0] says level 1 is 'a wash' (chart: Heimerdinger), whys[1] says concede the wave (chart: Skill), whys[2] says 'even at best' (chart: Kayle), whys[3] calls the grenade all-in 'a real window, respect it' (chart: Kayle), whys[4] says you finally out-range him (chart: Heimerdinger). The packet chart matches the prose on every one of those rows.
audit.why: One turret is not a zone at level 1; from level 2 a second turret plus 1325-range rockets wall a melee Kayle off the wave; the grenade stun into turret focus is his kill window at 4-5; and level 6 is where Divine Ascent and Divine Judgment flip it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 flipped in both layers as one atomic group to Skill, Heimerdinger, Skill, Heimerdinger, Kayle, with ratings and all five phases[].why lines rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues on this page: it says 'track CH-2 Grenade' nine times and never once gives the cooldown, so there is no way to know how long the window lasts.
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is 11s flat at every rank, and Hextech Micro-Rockets is 11/10/9/8/7 — those two numbers are the whole rhythm of the lane. Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 11s written into phases[3].why, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns; rockets' 11s into phases[1].why; 160s into phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says three times that Divine Judgment 'blanks' the grenade-rockets all-in. It does not: R is invulnerability, so the grenade stun still lands and holds you in place — only the damage is zeroed. The packet also flags that no Heimerdinger ability is ever named.
audit.why: A player who thinks R cancels the stun will ult inside the turret pocket and stand there stunned with no damage output while the ult expires.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and mid now state the stun lands and the damage does not — matching the correction the Heimerdinger-side audit already made. H-28 G, Hextech Micro-Rockets and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade now appear by name in the phases.

edits.before: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Identify how Heimerdinger contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — one H-28 G turret is not a zone yet, so take the safe CS at max range and stay out of his rocket lines.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade is down.
edits.after: A second turret plus Hextech Micro-Rockets (11s) wall you off the wave — concede CS and stay healthy.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Heimerdinger must walk into your range.
edits.after: Q shred and W sustain steady you, but you cannot contest his turret pocket as a melee — even at best, so farm at range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around CH-2 Grenade's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s) stuns you into turret focus and rockets — that is his all-in window, so never step into the pocket.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Heimerdinger's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and Divine Judgment (160s) eats the grenade-rocket burst — the stun lands, the damage does not, so clear his turrets.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Respect it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The CH-2 grenade is 11s flat at every rank — step up only when it is down.

edits.before: Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with a small AoE wave and R gives you a few seconds of invulnerability, so you finally out-range his turrets and can clear them while blanking the E grenade-into-rockets all-in.
edits.after: Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with a small AoE wave and R gives you invulnerability, so you finally out-range his turrets and clear them — his CH-2 grenade still stuns you, but under R the rockets deal nothing.

edits.before: Level 6 flips the whole lane: Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with a small AoE wave, so you can stand outside the turret pocket and clear it, and R gives you a few seconds of invulnerability that completely blanks his grenade-rockets all-in. Once your first item comes online (Nashor's into on-hit), E adds missing-health magic damage on every auto and extends your range — two or three AoE autos delete a turret, and the splash chunks Heimer behind it. Bait his E grenade, pop R if he commits with his team, and start farming his zone for free. This is where you stop being prey.
edits.after: Level 6 flips the whole lane: Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with a small AoE wave, so you can stand outside the turret pocket and clear it, and R gives you a few seconds of invulnerability that zeroes the grenade-rockets damage — the stun still lands. Once your first item comes online (Nashor's into on-hit), E adds missing-health magic damage on every auto and extends your range — two or three AoE autos delete a turret, and the splash chunks Heimer behind it. Bait his 11s E grenade, pop R if he commits, and start farming his zone for free.

notes: This chart was the worst of my slice: five of seven rows argued against their own why-text, and the packet chart agreed with the prose on every one. Flipped rows 0-4 as a single atomic group. IMPORTANT: the Heimerdinger-side audit deliberately left its chart alone (its note says it disagrees with packet.levelChart at rows 2-5 but its prose read better), so after this lands the two directions may disagree — see questionsForUser. Divine Judgment is damage immunity, not unstoppable: the grenade stun lands, the damage does not. That correction is now consistent on both pages.
